name: RRCL Expected Cashflow
query:
SELECT
    ecf.date,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ecf.direction = 'INFLOW' THEN ecf.amount ELSE 0 END) AS inflows,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ecf.direction = 'OUTFLOW' THEN ecf.amount ELSE 0 END) AS outflows,
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN ecf.direction = 'INFLOW' THEN ecf.amount
            WHEN ecf.direction = 'OUTFLOW' THEN -ecf.amount
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS netflow,
    count(*) as transactions
FROM `tabRRCL Expected Cashflow` AS ecf
WHERE ecf.date BETWEEN %(date_from)s AND %(date_to)s
GROUP BY ecf.date
ORDER BY ecf.date;
